topic.source_contract: Mandatory biodiversity net gain, metric, gain plan, exemptions and long-term delivery evidence

facts.objective: at least 10% biodiversity gain for in-scope development
facts.guard: future exemption is not applied before its commencement date

facts.exemptions: lists application, de-minimis, temporary and other exemptions
facts.de_minimis: less than 25 square metres of habitat and less than 5 metres of linear habitat
facts.guard: each exemption requires exact application date, red-line area and habitat impact evidence

facts.planning: gain condition and post-permission biodiversity gain plan framework
facts.commencement: approved gain plan required before development starts unless exempt
facts.guard: planning permission alone does not prove BNG discharge or habitat delivery

facts.submission: metric calculation, off-site register references and management information may be required
facts.gate: development cannot start until LPA approval of the gain plan
facts.guard: submitted plan is not an approved plan

facts.duration: legal agreement for significant gains must secure management for at least 30 years
facts.responsibility: creation, maintenance, management and monitoring responsibilities must be identified
facts.guard: HMMP supplements and does not replace the legal agreement

scope_guards: The 0.2-hectare exemption effective 6 August 2026 is not applied on 31 July 2026.
A planning permission is not treated as an approved biodiversity gain plan.
A submitted metric is not treated as an accepted baseline or delivered gain.
On-site, off-site units and statutory credits are kept as distinct delivery routes.
Statutory credits are not treated as the first delivery option.
Registered off-site units are not treated as allocated to a development without allocation evidence.
Habitat creation commitments are not treated as maintained habitat outcomes.
No score or promotion is written without exact habitat baseline, metric, legal security, allocation and approval.
